segments.name: Population Health Management
products: value-based care coordination and health management
care management, quality management and utilization management
segments.description: Provides value-based population health management and capitated care to Medicare Advantage insurance plans and their members on an at-risk basis.
segments.evidence: The Company's single segment generates revenue by providing population health management services on an at-risk basis to insurance plans offering medical coverage to Medicare beneficiaries under Medicare Advantage programs.

revenueModel.text: Health plans and payors pay the company per-member-per-month capitated fees to manage the care of their Medicare Advantage members on an at-risk basis.
revenueModel.evidence: Our platform focuses on Medicare Advantage and manages the needs of our members through subscription-like per-member-per-month ("PMPM") arrangements with health plans or payors.

changes.text: In 2024 the company sold its Florida assets to buyers affiliated with its principal stockholder.
changes.evidence: On November 30, 2024, the Company sold its Florida Assets to Buyers which are affiliated with the Company's principal stockholder.
